evidence.title: Google’s AI Mode can now track flight prices, help book hotels, and more
AI’s memory crunch is coming for Android apps
3 new ways to plan and book travel in Search

summary: Google's AI Mode now includes flight price tracking and hotel booking in Search, while Android apps face memory constraints due to AI integration. The updates aim to enhance travel planning but may impact app performance.
title: Google Expands AI-Powered Travel Features in Search and Android Apps
